# PYNK AI UGC Studio

Turn any product into a **realistic 15-second UGC ad** — without writing a single prompt yourself.
You answer a few questions; Claude writes every prompt and tells you exactly what to attach and how to run it.

## Setup

1. Open this folder in **Claude Code** (as its own project).
2. Type `/ugc` to start.

That's it — nothing to install. The skill writes **prompts**; you paste them into whatever image and video generators you use. It works with any of them.

## The pipeline

| Step | You do | You get |
|---|---|---|
| **1 · Model** | describe your creator | headshot + full-body image prompts |
| **2 · Product & Scene** | name your product, pick a scene | product and scene locked |
| **3 · Script** | write what she says | full overview + the Seedance master prompt |

Attach your three images in order, paste the master prompt, hit generate — and you've got a UGC ad that looks like a real person filmed it on their phone.

Every step, you just describe what you want — the Studio writes the prompts.
